title: H-HANDOFF-1 part B, the CLIENT'S FAST FOOD (fx-hq1 '11 ba:street_tenthavenue', full-service seats + the till queue): both inside with at least 6 customers, some SEATED; LEG 1 the owner (client, simulator) walks out and the host continues every seated customer on the SAME table seat with the row's remaining eating time and every queued customer in the SAME line; LEG 2 the owner walks back in - the AUTHORITY SWAP: the host (non-booking simulator) releases its crowd through ReactToAuthority, must leave NO leaked seat or queue place behind, and the owner takes the same seats / lines back. Money oracle handoffbook on the owner after each leg. NO save.
preconditions:
Reporter fixture session fx-hq1 (day 44, MERGED - vars.keepMerger true). Dev build with H-HANDOFF-1 part B (custstate held, BAMP_DEV). Setup as T-HANDOFF2: both step outside and take one consensus skip outdoors to 10:45 the next morning. The fast food at vars.shop is the CLIENT's (t-shopday-pick: 137 shopper entries a day, a staffed till), so the client books it and simulates it whenever he is inside.

WHY THE FAST FOOD: its customers queue at the till (CustomerJoinQueue -> a WaitingLine) and then sit and eat at a table (FullServiceSitInASeat: 1-2 min prep, then 10-18 min food / ice cream). The pooled release on the giving machine (CustomerPool.ActionOnRelease) freed neither the seat nor the queue place - every authority swap left them 'taken' there (part B step C). ORACLES: `custstate` natList entries carry :held=1/<table8>/<seat idx>/<endMin> and :q=<line8>/<spot>; `custstate held` prints the leak counts (spots marked taken with no live customer or pending want behind them) and the taker's rows vs bodies (heldSame / heldDone / heldPending / heldFallback / heldMismatch) and endDelta (max |live end - row EndMin| in game minutes). A want that could not be honoured logs '[SeatPins] want <id> (...) not taken: <reason>' - a legitimate fallback, counted as heldFallback. ORACLE NOTE: NullReferenceException carries the `(?<!swallowed )` lookbehind (fx-hq1's own Gley diagnostic).
oracles_absent: \[Handoff\] (capture|capture live|apply|apply visit|stream|exit snapshot|take-over|wait tick|final received|citizen|leave|send final)\b[^:]*:
